# Title: "Wildfires and Movies"
# execute:
  echo: false

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
raw <- read_json("data/wildfires.geojson")
length(raw$features)
```

```{r}
first_fire <- raw$features[[1]]
names(first_fire)
```

```{r}
first_coordinate <- first_fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][[1]]
first_coordinate
```

```{r}
features_tbl <- tibble(features = raw$features)
features_tbl
```

```{r}
features_wide <- features_tbl |> unnest_wider(features)
features_wide
```

```{r}
properties_wide <- features_wide |> unnest_wider(properties)
properties_wide
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
fires <- properties_wide |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
august_fires <- fires |> filter(str_detect(incident, "August"))
nrow(august_fires)

fires |> arrange(desc(gis_acres)) |> slice_head(n = 10)

ggplot(fires, aes(x = gis_acres)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  scale_x_log10()

acres_by_year <- fires |>
  group_by(fire_year) |>
  summarize(total_acres = sum(gis_acres, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(acres_by_year, aes(x = fire_year, y = total_acres)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Total Acres Burned by Year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Total Acres Burned",
    caption = "Source: Wildfire incident data"
  )

acres_by_state <- fires |>
  group_by(state) |>
  summarize(total_acres = sum(gis_acres, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  slice_max(total_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(state = fct_reorder(state, total_acres))

ggplot(acres_by_state, aes(x = state, y = total_acres)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 States by Total Acres Burned",
    x = "State",
    y = "Total Acres Burned",
    caption = "Source: Wildfire incident data"
  )
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  mutate(
    lon = map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(coordinates) {
      mean(map_dbl(coordinates[[1]], 1))
    }),
    lat = map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(coordinates) {
      mean(map_dbl(coordinates[[1]], 2))
    })
  )

big_fires

big_fires_by_agency <- big_fires |>
  count(agency, name = "number_of_fires")

ggplot(big_fires_by_agency, aes(x = agency, y = number_of_fires)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Big Fires by Managing Agency",
    x = "Managing Agency",
    y = "Number of Big Fires"
  )
```

```{r}
leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  setView(lng = -115, lat = 40, zoom = 4) |>
  addGeoJSON(jsonlite::toJSON(raw, auto_unbox = TRUE))
```
